description: Defines a Flutter widget 'RideBottomSheet' that displays ride details such as distance, fare, payment options, and a request ride button. It interacts with RideState and PaymentMethodSheet.

classes.name: RideBottomSheet
classes.description: A stateless widget that displays ride details and allows user interaction for requesting a ride and selecting payment methods.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree for the ride bottom sheet, displaying distance, fare, coupon, payment options, and request button.

methods.name: _showPaymentMethod
methods.description: Displays the payment method selection sheet.

methods.name: _onRequestRide
methods.description: Handles the ride request action, shows confirmation, and dismisses the bottom sheet.
